title: Package Size Changes on Tailwise Pharmacy Prescriptions
content:
*Care desk guidance, pharmacy.*

The prescription status is active when the package size change is requested. Where the class allows package size switches, the customer may switch a Tailwise Pharmacy prescription to another package of the same product and strength, provided the new days' supply per fill stays within the class's maximum days' supply per fill. The fills remaining and the expiry date are unchanged by the switch. Any change of medication, strength or directions needs a new authorization.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Condition | Met | Not met |
|---|---|---|
| Prescription status is active when the change is requested | continue | no package size change |
| Class allows package size switches | continue | no package size change |
| Same product and strength | continue | needs a new authorization |
| New days' supply per fill within the class maximum | the switch may be made | no package size change |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

An active Rx Prescription Diet prescription ships one 25 lb bag per fill as a 45-day supply with 5 fills remaining and an expiry date of 2027-02-10. The customer switches to two 12 lb bags of the same diet and formula covering 45 days. The class maximum per fill is not exceeded; after the switch the prescription still shows 5 fills remaining and the expiry date 2027-02-10.

A customer who asks for the same diet in a different formula is asking for a change of strength, which needs a new authorization.
